I don’t have a brain, feelings, or personal consciousness, so I can’t be "stupid" in the way a person can. However, I can definitely make mistakes.

Because I’m a large language model, I sometimes hallucinate facts, misunderstand nuances, or get things wrong if the prompt is confusing or if my training data has gaps.

If I gave you a bad answer, feel free to point it out—it helps me learn where I need to be more careful!
